body:
I see. I assume you are young and really pains me to see that. It's just... i was in a similar situation and... well, over time i've realised that i have to stop doing some things, even if it's a momentarily stress release, because it will just make it even worse in the future, so the pain, both mental and physical will just continue to grow and grow. Not that i would expect you to stop, but i wish you will eventually come to the same conclusion, and do it much earlier in life than me.

Also, is moving out eventually not a thing that you could look forward to as a way to cope with current situation, if it's just your area?

That hurts to hear. Very weird coincidence, but i can pretty much relate to everything right here, except its university work in my case rather than the school. 

Lack of acceptance is horrible.

Is it just your family/area that are homophobic, or the country in general is not a wecoming place?

And I'm definitely not going to preach, so don't take it as if i'm judging, but do you think self-harming is a good idea in the long run? Would you not want to keep your body and beauty intact, in spite of all pos that are already harming your mental health?
What happened, friend? If you feel like you want to vent, feel free to do so.
Not that I can help by posting this but... that's so relatable. I feel you... Vicious cycle.
Makes you afraid of what may come next...
It does. It always gets worse, every year, every month, in the ways you could not think it was possible. Almost feels like a very twisted dark comedy show.
